messages:
jen: FYI viewers are seeing a black box on the stream and captions are ~15s behind. audio seems stable though. @video-team can we triage? :rotating_light:
mark: looking at the encoder - intermittent frame drops. pulling a short log now.
mark: ```enc-9 WARN: keyframe_interval=2.1s
enc-9 ERROR: reconnect to ingest failed twice```
priya: can we flip to backup ingest like last time? we should also start a local capture in case the hosted archive misses segments.
gabe: prepping DNS switch. requesting cam SDs from stage ops. will coordinate 30s before swap.
ops-bot: Incident created IN-2024-777: all-hands video degraded -> paging video-team.
emma: starting local OBS capture to /tmp/allhands_local_1769999999.mkv. command: `obs-cli --startrecording`
zach: checked NDI paths; camera still sending but keyframe gap shows. could be a network hiccup at the stage switcher.
leo: leadership prefers to continue Q&A if audio is good. propose slide: "Video degraded; continuing audio Q&A" and proceed.
jen: agree. putting that slide up now and notifying attendees.
mark: performing DNS flip in 5...4...3... swapped. monitoring reconnect.
mark: backup ingest accepted stream, bitrate stabilizing. can folks confirm video? :eyes:
emma: player shows video returning, local file growing. will checksum after upload.
priya: notice: hosted archive missing about 1m around the glitch. Gabe, can we pull cam1 SD to fill the gap?
gabe: stage ops handing over cam1 SD now. copying to s3://allhands-raw/1769999999/cam1/ (upload started).
leo: once SD finishes I'll stitch cam1 with emma's local capture and produce a short clip. ETA ~20m.
mark: encoder logs uploaded to s3://infra-logs/allhands/1769999999/encoder.log (video-team access granted).
priya: action: enable automatic local-record fallback for all-hands so we don't rely on manual starts. ops-bot?
ops-bot: Action logged: TICKET-ALLHANDS-99 "Enable automatic local-record fallback" assigned to ops.
zach: suggestion for UI: add a small heartbeat overlay like "last keyframe: Xs" so we can spot stalls earlier.
jen: adding that to postmortem list. thank you team for quick switch and keeping Q&A live. will share stitched clip and follow-ups when ready.
emma: if anyone needs the raw local file before stitch, ping me and I'll drop it in the shared bucket.
leo: uploaded stitched clip and notes to https://storage.redwood.ai/allhands/1769999999/stitched-clip.mp4. posted short timestamps.
jen: confirmed receipt. closing thread and creating follow-ups in the all-hands runbook. :white_check_mark:
